svg.title: Two overhangs facing each other across a V-score
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, three side views of two boards joined by a V-score. A connector on the top of board B hangs 7 mm past the score, over board A. A connector on the underside of board A hangs 7 mm past the score, under board B. Top left: as placed, with the key beside it. Below left: board B bent up to snap the score; its own connector comes down onto board A, marked in red. Below right: board B bent down; board B comes down onto board A's connector, marked in red. Each overhang blocks one direction, so the score can't be snapped either way.

g.text: Board B's connector lands on board A
Board B lands on board A's connector
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Each overhang blocks one way of bending, so together they block both.
Fix: keep overhangs off breakaway edges, or route the edge and leave a relief cut-out (D24).
